## Authority and research rule

The North Star, Architecture §7.2–7.3 and Research Brief govern this frontier.
Architecture provisionally prefers physiology/regulation through interoception to
embodied pressure. The historical stored Need meter remains a control, not a coequal
default. Keeping ownership experimental does not erase that architectural preference.
Psychological/social motives may have other substrates; this experiment cannot settle
their ownership by analogy to a body variable.

Required phenomenon → public expressibility check → minimum missing seam → reviewed
contract → public fixture → serious competing models → bounded verdict → next gap.
Missing coverage blocks the verdicts it could plausibly invalidate, not the entire
program. Every reduction packet must name absent incoming/outgoing paths and explain
their relevance. Missing affect-to-retrieval can invalidate a broad memory reduction;
it does not automatically block an independent RNG comparison. No general Campaign 4
ranking follows from the present subset of representable families.

## Existing substrate and expressibility boundary

| Existing surface | Reuse boundary |
|---|---|
| `regulatory-reference/0.5-candidate`, implemented in `src/campaign2/regulatoryReference.ts` | Immutable authored R0 and exact R0+D validity. Neither an evolving physiological state nor a learned baseline. |
| Qualified diagnostic probe and measurement-evidence carriage | Demonstrate observer-safe carriage and provenance. R0+D diagnostics do not establish a physical body variable or general interoception. |
| SEM/PRJ/IDN and OutcomeEvaluation → CharacterLearningEvidence | Preserve admitted observer/subject identity, evidence permissions and existing occurrence ancestry. No parallel truth-ID provenance scheme or direct truth-to-learning route. |
| Qualified task cognitive path, motives and reason coverage | A real commitment source and bounded within-nucleus receiving controls. Two task identifiers do not provide heterogeneous motive families. |
| Deterministic time, transactions, state ownership and persistence | Reuse exact accepted substrate; a new body state still needs an explicit sole writer, time law and persistence contract. |

The first blocker is semantic: no accepted contract yet gives a dynamic body variable
its physical interpretation, legitimate interoceptive exposure and embodied-source
production law. Existing REG arithmetic cannot fill that gap by renaming R0 or D.
The second blocker is receiving: provenance can expose possible overlap but does not
determine whether two motivational grounds should consolidate. Current task model
admission must not be widened by an unchecked parameter or authored raw signal.

## First bounded experiment

Start with one explicitly interpreted embodied quantity, one deterministic exposure
channel and one interoceptive observation channel. Select exact units, kinetics,
interval semantics and time boundaries in a subsequent seam draft; do not borrow
`unit/fixture-pulse` as a physiological unit or introduce conversion by implication.
No hydration, hunger, reward or stress label is accepted merely by choosing a scalar.

The minimum useful fixture must support all these independent contrasts:

1. Equal current levels with different admitted kinetic parameters yield different
   later trajectories. A memoryless level control must have a real chance to fail.
2. Different hidden body states with identical permitted evidence yield identical
   embodied-source outputs when other admitted operands match. Direct truth reading
   fails this control; uncertainty cannot silently collapse to an exact hidden value.
3. Equal body truth with different legitimate interoceptive sensitivity can yield
   different evidence and pressure. No hand-authored pressure intermediate is allowed.
4. A publicly generated embodied source and the existing commitment source address
   the same option. Include both independent motivational grounds and duplicated
   descriptions of shared support; dropping all but one source cannot win by default.

The first fixture need not learn a new persistent Need state, implement affect feedback
or require attention competition. Those remain absent paths to assess when interpreting
its result. If the fixture requires finite-capacity selection, ATTN-001 becomes a real
dependency at that point; it is otherwise a separate contract investigation.

## Ownership alternatives to preserve

| Candidate | Discriminating question and limit |
|---|---|
| Interoception-derived embodied pressure | Can current permitted evidence and declared context reproduce the required trajectory and choice contrasts without additional retained pressure? Preferred first embodied hypothesis. |
| Additional stored pressure | Does matched current evidence with different legitimate prior history require retained dynamics? Must name acquisition, writer and forgetting law; old CTL-001 is a control. |
| Hybrid | Does a retained contributor add a distinction that neither instantaneous evidence nor already retained body/evidence history explains? Avoid duplicated state authority. |
| Body-derived representation | May simplify truth-side dynamics, but cognitive pressure still crosses the interoceptive boundary. A direct hidden-body reader is an adversarial shortcut, not an admissible character model. |
| Irreducible psychological motive | Remains available for suitable psychological phenomena. This bounded embodied fixture cannot establish or eliminate it globally. |

Equal behavior in this fixture earns only domain-bounded equivalence. A new stored
family is not required merely to make the topology look complete.

## Source promise before record shapes

The embodied producer must expose its subject through accepted identity admission,
its source family, option/motive meaning and sufficient **observer-safe** causal
ancestry to inspect possible shared support. Reuse admitted evidence references and
occurrences. Hidden common world IDs cannot become overlap keys. A typed reference
must not grant broader evidence-read authority indirectly.

Evidence overlap and independent motivation are separate questions: two motives may
legitimately use the same perceived fact. Do not decide a cross-family normalization,
pairwise maximum or one-die-per-description law here. Preserve MEC-013/014 and
EXP-009/014 controls and review explicit receiving alternatives against both cases.
The existing within-nucleus law remains authoritative in its accepted domain.

## Attention investigation alongside BODY

| Question | Boundary to specify; no new ownership allocated here |
|---|---|
| PERMITTED? | Observation/epistemic admission determines evidence this observer can receive. Attention cannot authorize hidden truth. |
| ATTENDED? | Perception/attention selects active processing under explicit capacity; selection does not imply new facts. |
| ENCODING STRENGTH? | An encoding/learning contract determines imprint from admitted inputs; selection alone is not its complete law. |
| ACCESSIBLE NOW? | Retrieval determines current access to retained representation; unselected does not mean erased or never stored. |

MEC-005 remains CONTROL+CONTRACT; MEC-007 and CTL-004 remain controls; RET-001 remains
retired. Residual-pool salience is a comparison mechanism. No generic Salience scalar
owns all four answers. Any affect/familiarity influence must name the receiving
operation and temporal edge rather than silently modifying history.

## Next contract work and deliberately deferred decisions

## ATTENTION — Evidence selection and encoding footprint

**Version:** intake/0.1-draft. **Historical intake:** MEC-005/007/008, EXP-007/015,
CTL-004, RET-001. **Brief coverage:**12.3/12.6.

**Required setup domain:** One observer, fixed permitted sensory inputs, more eligible
items than active capacity; two events with the same focal causal evidence but different
irrelevant tag counts. Keep permission, active selection, encoding strength and later
accessibility separately observable. A residual attention pool and salience factors
belong to named comparison models; they are not required representations for every
candidate or authored reinforcement values supplied to bypass their eventual seams.

**Interventions:** Change only attention allocation, focal event-specific causal role,
or irrelevant semantic footprint; independently disable the attention effect.

**Observable obligation:** Capacity limits selection separately from visibility and
admissibility; unchanged ignored truth cannot enter cognition. Irrelevant tag count
must not silently determine focal evidence/learning strength.

**Causal counterfactual obligation:** Compare historical independent-budget salience,
an explicit shared-budget alternative and retired flat tagging. Record any footprint
dependence rather than declaring a preferred allocation law equivalent in advance.

**Epistemic obligation:** Attention operates on permitted evidence, not hidden truth
salience. Event-role evidence is observer-relative; historical truth provenance is
not copied into character inputs.
